description: This PHP source file defines the CallsApiController class, which handles API requests related to 'calls' in the Goteo project. It includes a method for listing calls with filtering, pagination, and permission checks.

classes.name: CallsApiController
classes.description: Controller class for handling API requests about calls, extending AbstractApiController, providing the callsAction method for listing calls.

methods.name: callsAction
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list calls with optional filtering based on query parameters such as 'q', 'status', and 'pag'. Performs permission checks and formats the list of calls for JSON response.
